title: Assignments use exclude filters but never include filters
when: Facts.Derived.Assignables.Any(o => o.Assignments.Any(a => a.FilterId != null && a.FilterMode == 'exclude')) && !Facts.Derived.Assignables.Any(o => o.Assignments.Any(a => a.FilterId != null && a.FilterMode == 'include'))

messages.businessImpact: Filters exist only as carve-outs from broad assignments, which usually means All Devices or All Users is doing the real targeting and exclusions are accumulating unpaid debt.
remediation: Prefer include filters that describe the intended population, and shrink the underlying group or All-target assignments.
messages.cannotSee: The filter list and every supported assignable workload must be collected, or this check skips rather than calling a tenant one that never includes. A tenant using include filters only on a workload outside that list is not credited. Whether a filter is correct is CFG-014, CFG-015 and HYG-013.
